sections.title: Section A — Integration and limits
sections.criteria: LaTeX-formatted working and method required, not just the final value

questions.prompt: Evaluate \(\int_0^1 3x^2 e^{x^3}\,dx\). Show the substitution explicitly.
questions.marking_criteria: 4 pts for the substitution \(u = x^3\), 4 pts for transformed bounds \(u : 0 \to 1\), 2 pts for the value \(e - 1\)
6 pts for reducing to an exponential limit (e.g. \(e^{n \ln(1 + 2/n)}\)), 4 pts for the value \(e^2\)

sections.title: Section B — Series convergence
sections.criteria: Name the convergence test used and verify its hypotheses

questions.prompt: Determine whether \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{n!}{n^n}\) converges. Justify with a named test.
questions.marking_criteria: 5 pts for a correct ratio-test setup, 5 pts for the limit \(1/e < 1\) and the conclusion
6 pts for the integral test or Cauchy condensation with hypotheses checked, 4 pts for a correct evaluation; a bare comparison with \(\sum 1/n^2\) is invalid and earns at most 2 pts
